basic_info.description: Welcome to this beautifully remodeled tri-level home located in the desirable Outer Sunset neighborhood. The inviting front porch leads into a spacious living area adorned with gleaming hardwood floors that seamlessly flow into the dining room and mainlevel bedroom. The open-concept kitchen is a chef's delight, featuring stainless steel appliances, ample cabinetry, and a cozy eat-in nook. Two contemporary bathrooms complement the home's design, and an additional loft-style bedroom offers versatile space, perfect for a home office or guest suite. The ground level boasts a modern in-law suite with one bedroom and one bath, complete with a private entrance-ideal for extended family or potential rental income. A one-car garage provides secure parking, and the beautifully paved driveway enhances the property's curb appeal.  Situated just blocks from Ocean Beach and Golden Gate Park, this home offers unparalleled access to outdoor recreation. Enjoy the convenience of nearby shops, restaurants, and grocery stores, all within walking distance. Effortless commuting is ensured with easy access to MUNI.....connecting you to the vibrant offerings of San Francisco
